gate: >=92/96 jointly correct quartets per layout and seed. Gate includes occurrence, expression, address and effects. Benchmark only deployable arms that pass all layouts.
scope: Synthetic instrumented study. Two expression spans and episodic bindings supplied, fixed dictionary, whitespace tokenization with spaced separators. Counterbalance reference and approval order. Held-out templates and roster, no new cue vocabulary. Training labels the governing reference occurrence. Compare proximity, clause-first deterministic baseline, and learned occurrence scorer.
